risk_if_not_implemented: Without Personally-Owned Mobile Devices, mobile and portable devices may expose organizational data through loss, theft, insecure configuration or unauthorized use. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Centralized Management Of Mobile Devices
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to implement and govern Mobile Device Management (MDM) controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Centralized Management Of Mobile Devices (MDM-02) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Personally-Owned Mobile Devices (MDM-06) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Software Usage Restrictions
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce software usage restrictions to comply with applicable contract agreements and copyright laws.
compensating_control_2.justification: Software Usage Restrictions (CFG-11) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Personally-Owned Mobile Devices (MDM-06) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
